description: The VALUE-implied PICTURE clause (ISO §2023:13.16.3 SR9 for a data description entry, §2023:13.15.3 SR14 for a report group description entry - the SAME rule in the two general formats, and one gate) - 'The PICTURE clause may be omitted for an elementary item when an alphanumeric, boolean, or national literal that is not a zero-length literal is specified in the data-item format of the VALUE clause', the implied clause being 'PICTURE X(length)' / '1(length)' / 'N(length)' with 'length ... as specified in 8.3.3, Literals'. COBOL-85 had no such grant: a PICTURE was required for every elementary item bar an index data item and the subject of a RENAMES clause, so the whole rule is a post-85 addition and this row carries its ALPHANUMERIC arm's introduction. SR9's boolean and national arms are gated a second time and independently by boolean-data-2002 / national-data-2002, since the literal forms themselves are 2002 additions. The figurative-constant spelling rides the same grant (§2023:8.3.3.1 makes a figurative constant a literal; §2023:8.3.3.6.4 GR3 b/c supply the length, one character for a bare figurative and literal-1's length for ALL literal-1) - kb/Work PB828 the adjudication, PB504 the rule, PB831 the ALL-literal length.
display: the VALUE-implied PICTURE clause (an elementary item with a VALUE literal and no PICTURE)
vcr: 2002 introduction (derive from the 2002 standard); no VERSION_CHANGE_REFERENCE row - that ledger carries no 85->2002 row set
